newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: KRUGER LIONS DEVOUR MOTHER AND CHILD.
newsitem.headline: KRUGER LIONS DEVOUR MOTHER AND CHILD.

text.p: Lions in South Africa's largest nature reserve killed and ate two illegal immigrants crossing into the country from neighbouring Mozambique this week, park officials said on Friday.
The two, a woman and her child, were among a group of 11 people trying to make their way through the Kruger National Park on the country's northeastern border, on Monday night.

Bruce Bryden, senior manager of conservation services at the reserve, said police, soldiers and rangers found their remains after a search in the north of the park, which is roughly the same size as Israel -- 20,000 sq km (7,500 sq miles).
"People are soft-skinned and soft-boned and if the lions and hyenas have been at them, the chances of finding something is slim," he told Reuters.
According to others in the group of migrants, the two were separated after being disturbed by an elephant. They were lost in the dark and the others then heard them screaming.
Millions of illegal immigrants have streamed into South Africa from neighbouring countries in recent years and tens of thousands are repatriated to Mozambique every year.
